audit.whatIsWrong: This side's chart read Volibear, Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, while the audited mirror (morde__volibear) shipped Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Skill, Mordekaiser, Volibear, Volibear. Every stage from level 1 to two items disagreed across the two pages, and the content prose here argued the exact opposite shape (Volibear early, Mordekaiser late).
audit.why: The mirror is already applied, so leaving this alone means one champion's page tells a paying user Volibear wins level 1 and the other says it is even, and the late game is claimed by both sides.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side and win[0..6] both set to Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Skill, Mordekaiser, Volibear, Volibear, ratings 5, 4, 4, 5, 4, 6, 7, with every contradicting why/spike/prose line rewritten to match: his window is levels 2-6, yours is first item onward.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and report[2].t both claimed 'you spike levels 3-6 hard', which is the inverse of the corrected chart.
audit.why: Obliterate is free to cast on an 8/7/6/5/4s cooldown and hits harder against a single target, Darkness Rise switches on after three hits, and Realm of Death lands at 6 — those are his windows. Volibear's are the Sundered Sky first item and the two-item brawl, where Grievous Wounds and MR blunt the shield-heal.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] and [1] restated as his windows with real cooldowns; spikes[2] and [3] restated as yours; breakdown.spikes and report[2].t re-anchored.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated what Indestructible actually does. It called it a shield that 'tanks your combo' and said nothing about him consuming it to heal — which is the half that Grievous Wounds turns off.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.' The heal is the reason Executioner's Calling matters in this lane, and report[8].t already buys it without ever telling the player why.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds cuts the heal he takes from consuming Indestructible (12/11/10/9/8s). Death's Grasp pulls on 16/14/12/10/8s — the gap after it is your window to spend Thundering Smash's 300-unit charge and cash both Frenzied Maul bites on its 5s timer.
sources: brief enemyKit W/E Riot text and cooldowns

audit.why: breakdown.cooldowns already carries Realm of Death and Death's Grasp, and the mirror added the real Thundering Smash and Frenzied Maul timers on its side.

edits.before: W start for the bite-trade, or Q into aggressive lanes. Even exchanges favour you because the passive lightning ramps as the trade extends.
edits.after: W start for the bite-trade. Exchanges are even: Obliterate costs him nothing to throw, but your bite heals where his poke does not.

edits.before: Level 1 is yours — you out-brawl Morde before his kit and passive come online.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: his Obliterate costs no mana, but your W bite trades back.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Mordekaiser has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Obliterate is free to cast and hits harder on you alone — walk up only once he has thrown it.

edits.before: Level 2 stays yours as W's heal beats his Q Obliterate poke in trades.
edits.after: Level 2 is his — Obliterate hits harder on a single target, free to cast.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Mordekaiser under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter shields you at 1200 range as you back off, but three of his hits turn on Darkness Rise and the aura wins long fights.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you: full combo all-in wins while his sustain is weak.
edits.after: Level 3 is his: Obliterate plus the E pull keeps you inside his aura.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Mordekaiser down every time Realm of Death is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard, and his E pull is down 12s at rank 3 — that gap is your window to stun in and cash both bites.

edits.before: Level 4-5 remains yours since you out-heal and out-damage his early poke.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are even — your Q stun answers his 12s E pull if you time it.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Mordekaiser under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables towers, but this level is his: Realm of Death takes you somewhere your minions, tower and jungler cannot follow.

edits.before: Level 6 is even — his R isolation trades off against your Q stun, a coin-flip.
edits.after: Level 6 is his — Realm of Death isolates you with no minions to fall back on.

edits.before: First item is a toss-up as Riftmaker sustain and his shield blunt your burst.
edits.after: First item is yours: Sundered Sky heals through Indestructible's shield.

edits.before: At 2+ items Mordekaiser out-scales you — R isolates and his sustain wins the duel.
edits.after: At 2+ items you win — MR and Grievous Wounds blunt his shield and his heal.

edits.before: Before Morde has his full kit online you out-brawl him: Q Thundering Smash stuns and W Frenzied Maul's on-hit heal beats his early Q Obliterate poke, so trade whenever his Q is on cooldown and deny his passive stacks.
edits.after: Obliterate costs him no mana and hits harder on a single target, so trade only when it is down — 6s at rank 3. Q Thundering Smash stuns and Frenzied Maul's second bite heals, but three of his hits switch on Darkness Rise.

edits.before: His R Realm of Death is the swing point — he can 1v1-isolate you in the death realm where he steals your stats, so bait it out or fight near your tower; the level is a coin-flip on who lands CC first.
edits.after: Realm of Death is his window — a 140s ult at rank 1 that drags you 1v1 and steals your stats, with no minions, tower or jungler to fall back on. Bait it or hold Flash, and fight only once he has burned it.

edits.before: With Riftmaker/Rylai's Morde's DoT and E pull sustain make his death-realm duel hard to win, and his shield from Indestructible blunts your burst — the item window is a toss-up.
edits.after: Your first item flips it: Sundered Sky's heal on the first hit plus Frenzied Maul's 5s re-bite out-sustain Indestructible, which he has to consume as a heal to get real value out of it.

edits.before: Late game Mordekaiser out-scales you: his R isolates and deletes you 1v1, his passive and Riftmaker sustain out-heal your damage, and his shield tanks your combo, so the very late duel is his.
edits.after: Late you hold the duel: Grievous Wounds and MR cut the heal he takes from Indestructible, Stormbringer's bonus health survives the realm, and his 100s rank-3 R is the only real window he has left.

edits.before: You own the early lane. Before Mordekaiser has his full kit, your Q Thundering Smash stun and the sustain from W Frenzied Maul beat his Q Obliterate poke — trade every time his Q is down and you'll out-heal and out-damage him. Deny his passive Darkness Rise stacks by not letting him free-cast on the wave, and build a lead before his ult comes online.
edits.after: The early lane is his. Obliterate costs no mana and hits harder when it catches you alone, and three hits switch on the Darkness Rise aura. Hold Thundering Smash until his Q is spent — 8s at rank 1 — then stun in, Frenzied Maul twice for the heal-bite, and step out. Farm the levels you cannot fight and deny his stacks by not standing on the wave.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay yours as you keep brawling him down, but at 6 the matchup becomes a coin-flip. His R Realm of Death drags you into a 1v1 where he steals a chunk of your stats, so bait the ult or fight near your tower and minions. Whoever lands CC first — your Q stun or his E pull — wins the death-realm exchange.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 even out as your Q stun answers his E pull, which is down 12s at rank 3. Level 6 is his: Realm of Death drags you into a 1v1 where he steals a chunk of your stats and no minions or tower can help. Bait it, or hold Flash for the moment the realm drops and walk clear of his aura.

edits.before: Late game tilts to Mordekaiser. His R reliably isolates and deletes you 1v1, Riftmaker and his passive out-heal your damage, and Indestructible's shield tanks your full combo. Press your early advantage hard and avoid solo duels once he's itemized — take the fight with your team or in the sidelane only when his R is on cooldown.
edits.after: Late game tilts back to you. Grievous Wounds cuts the heal he takes from consuming Indestructible, magic resist blunts his aura, and Stormbringer's bonus health plus Frenzied Maul's 5s re-bite carry the long brawl he needs to win. Take the sidelane and duel him once his 100s ult is spent, and leap onto his tower to break the dive.

edits.before: All-in early before his kit spikes
edits.after: Fight once his Obliterate is spent

edits.before: You spike levels 3-6 hard — that's the kill window. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Your window opens at the first item — see the level-by-level chart for the swing points and his level 6.

edits.before: Mordekaiser: Realm of Death online, level 6, first item. Volibear: levels 3-6 all-in power, the Stormbringer tower-disable dive, Sundered Sky first item, Sundered Sky first-item spike.
edits.after: Mordekaiser: Obliterate ranks, Darkness Rise online, Realm of Death at 6. Volibear: the Sundered Sky first-item spike, the Grievous Wounds buy, and the two-item drain-tank brawl with Stormbringer up.
